senses.gloss:
ITA-9.6.42 viṃśatiśastrāṇi विंशतिशस्त्राणि
Twenty sharp surgical instruments
The 20 sharp instruments used in surgical procedures.

ITA-5.41.1.5 vinatā-pramehapiḍakā विनता-प्रमेहपिडका
Carbuncle characterized by large size and blue-coloured lesion
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a blue-coloured boil; deep-rooted on back; deep-rooted on abdomen; painful eruption; moistening/ soddening eruption; large vesicular swelling.

ITA-9.6.29 vinamanakarma विनमनकर्म
Depression
A therapeutic measure in which elevated parts are pressed downwards.

ITA-1.9.3.3.28 vinayaḥ विनयः
Humility
A term that expresses proper conduct, decency, modesty or mildness.
